x, y, n = map(int, input().split())

def nod(a, b):
    if a == 0:
        return b
    elif b == 0:
        return a
    return nod(b, a % b)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    a, b = 0, 0
    if n >= y:
        m = nod(x, y)
        a = x // m
        b = y // m
    else:
        m = 1000050000.0
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            aa = int((x * i) / y)  # floor
            if abs(aa / i - (x / y)) < m:
                a = aa
                b = i
                m = abs(aa / i - (x / y))
            aa = int((x * i + y - 1) // y)  # ceil
            if abs(aa / i - (x / y)) < m:
                a = aa
                b = i
                m = abs(aa / i - (x / y))
    print(f"{a}/{b}")
